label: cGMP binding
candidate_action_lead: Retain; consider adding an ISS/ISM line anchored on PMID:28099415 (TAX-4 cGMP-bound structure)
rationale: Structure-anchored alignment shows the full phosphate-binding cassette and the guanine Thr and C-helix Asp are conserved and under elevated constraint. Binding by TAX-2 itself has never been measured, so the term should stay inferential, not be upgraded to IDA.

label: intracellularly cGMP-activated cation channel activity
rationale: Correctly qualified: TAX-2 alone makes no channel, activity is only seen in the TAX-4/TAX-2 heteromer.

label: intracellularly cAMP-activated cation channel activity
candidate_action_lead: Lead: remove, or add NOT, or replace with the parent GO:0005221
rationale: Contradicted by the only direct measurement on this channel: the TAX-4/TAX-2 heteromer remains highly selective for cGMP over cAMP (PMID:10064800). This looks like phylogenetic carry-over from cAMP-responsive family members.

label: cation channel complex
candidate_action_lead: Retain; consider the more specific GO:0017071
rationale: The heteromer is a cyclic-nucleotide-activated cation channel, so the child term is supported by the same reference.

label: non-motile cilium
candidate_action_lead: Lead: consolidate annotations across the two C. elegans tax-2 accessions
rationale: G5EEE2 and P90975 are the same 800 aa protein but carry disjoint annotation sets, so a curator reading only G5EEE2 misses the experimental ciliary localization.
